content: Orb Producer Suite was acquired by LANDR and rebranded LANDR Composer. Feature surface: AI-powered chord progression generation; assistive MIDI generation for chords, basslines, melodies, arpeggios with customizable modifiers (polyphony, humanization); scenes + song mode for arranging multiple ideas; piano roll MIDI editing; preset sounds (Bass/Keys/Lead/Pad); DAW sync; drag-and-drop MIDI export; supports all standard Western keys/modes with chord extensions and inversions.
